text_blocks.snippet: In June 2022, the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 0.75 percentage points, marking the largest increase since 1994. This move was aimed at curbing high inflation, which had reached a 40-year high. The Fed's decision to increase rates more aggressively than initially anticipated was influenced by a stronger-than-expected inflation report.
